import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX = 505;
    static long[][] C = new long[MAX][MAX];
    static long[] dpA = new long[MAX];
    static long[] dpB = new long[MAX];
    static long[][] dpC = new long[MAX][MAX];
    static long[][] dpD = new long[MAX][MAX];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        long mod = sc.nextLong();

        // Initialize binomial coefficients
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX; i++) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            C[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j]) % mod;
            }
        }

        // Initialize dpA and dpB
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX; i++) {
            dpA[i] = 0;
            dpB[i] = 0;
        }
        dpA[0] = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i < MAX; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                long sum = 0;
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    sum = (sum + dpA[k - 1] * dpA[i - k] % mod * C[i - 1][k - 1]) % mod;
                }
                dpA[i] = ((long) (i + 1) * sum) % mod;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < MAX; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                long sum = 0;
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    long t1 = (dpA[k - 1] * dpB[i - k] + dpB[k - 1] * dpA[i - k]) % mod;
                    long c = C[i - 1][k - 1];
                    sum = (sum + ((long) (i + 1) * c % mod) * t1) % mod;

                    long t2 = (k * (k - 1) / 2 + (i - k) * (i - k + 1) / 2) % mod;
                    sum = (sum + c * dpA[k - 1] % mod * dpA[i - k] % mod * t2) % mod;
                }
                dpB[i] = sum;
            }
        }

        // Initialize dpC and dpD
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAX; j++) {
                dpC[i][j] = 0;
                dpD[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        dpC[0][0] = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i < MAX; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                long v1 = dpC[i - 1][j];
                long v2 = dpD[i - 1][j];
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    long t1 = (dpC[i - k - 1][j - k] * dpA[k] % mod * C[j][k]) % mod;
                    long t2 = (dpC[i - k - 1][j - k] * dpB[k] % mod * C[j][k]) % mod;
                    long t3 = (dpD[i - k - 1][j - k] * dpA[k] % mod * C[j][k]) % mod;

                    v1 = (v1 + t1) % mod;
                    v2 = (v2 + t2 + t3) % mod;
                }
                dpC[i][j] = v1;
                dpD[i][j] = v2;
            }
            dpC[i][i] = dpA[i];
            dpD[i][i] = dpB[i];
        }

        System.out.println(dpD[n][m]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
